title: Static on the Line
description: Late-night radio host Arjun Kapoor collapses live on air from a fast-acting sedative. Reconstruct the timeline to unmask the perpetrator.

assets.altText: Late-night radio studio with microphone, unfinished coffee cup, and broadcast controls
Corrupted caller recording from 20 minutes before the broadcast collapse

sections.title: Section 1: The Missing Dose
sections.narrative: At 11:00 PM, radio host Arjun Kapoor slumped over his microphone during a live call-in show. Hospital toxicology reveals a fast-acting sedative. The first lead points to the studio medical supplies, where code RX-114 is unaccounted for.

questions.prompt: Inspect the medical inventory logs and pharmacy cross-check. What category of substance was missing item RX-114?

hints.hintText: The compound is a pharmaceutical downer used to suppress agitation.

sections.title: Section 2: The Name That Disappeared
sections.narrative: The front desk security log records everyone entering and leaving the broadcast suite. One signature on the 10:30 PM entry has been violently crossed out with black fountain pen ink.

questions.prompt: Examine the studio sign-in roster. Whose name was crossed out in an attempt to fabricate an early alibi?

hints.hintText: Look at the producer's initials beside the scratched timestamp.

sections.title: Section 3: The Second Entry
sections.narrative: While the main lobby camera shows no second entry, the rear fire-escape sensor logged a latch release at 10:48 PM, shortly before Arjun went on air.

questions.prompt: True or False: The rear fire-exit surveillance footage confirms Deepak re-entered the studio after his departure was recorded.

hints.hintText: Review the timecode on camera feed #04 covering the alley door.

sections.title: Section 4: Static on the Line
sections.narrative: Twenty minutes before the broadcast collapse, an anonymous caller phoned the hotline. The transmission suffered electromagnetic interference, but key words were recovered.

questions.prompt: Listen to the wiretap recording. What drink container does the frantic caller tell Arjun to inspect before he drinks from it?

metadata.transcript: Arjun... don't touch it... check the coffee before you drink it, Arjun... he came back through the fire door...

hints.hintText: The host's ceramic mug was found knocked over on the desk.

sections.title: Section 5: The Exit Plan
sections.narrative: In the producer's locked desk drawer, investigators uncover an unsent resignation draft detailing a fraudulent kickback scheme, alongside travel tickets.

questions.prompt: Decipher the travel destination found with the producer's confession letter: 'By the time you read this I\'ll be in ____'

hints.hintText: The seaside coastal state known for domestic holiday flights.

clues.title: Pharmacy Dispensation Record
clues.clueText: RX-114 sedative was officially prescribed to Deepak Nair three weeks prior to the poisoning.

clues.title: Draft Resignation & Ad-Fraud Exposure
clues.clueText: Arjun had drafted a memo exposing Deepak's illegal kickback scheme, giving Deepak immediate motive.

clues.title: Crossed-Out Sign-In Sheet
clues.clueText: Deepak crossed out his name on the studio sign-out log to establish an alibi that he had departed.

clues.title: Fire-Exit Surveillance Still
clues.clueText: Surveillance camera #4 captured Deepak slipping back into the studio through the alley fire exit.

clues.title: Anonymous Hotline Warning Tape
clues.clueText: Sunita phoned into the show warning Arjun not to drink from his coffee mug moments before he collapsed.
